name: Kardan Real Estate Enterprise and Development Ltd
summary: Kardan Real Estate Enterprise and Development Ltd plans, constructs, develops, builds, and manages residential building and income-producing properties in Israel. It also engages in the development of projects in the field of residential, office, hotel, and commercial; rental of office buildings, commercial space, and a parking lot; and undertaking of urban renewal projects. Kardan Real Estate Enterprise and Development Ltd was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Tel Aviv-Yafo, Israel. Kardan Real Estate Enterprise and Development Ltd operates as a subsidiary of kardan Israel Ltd.
